channels.name: The 360 Electrician
channels.description: Jeff, a Master Electrician and business coach — 'the #1 resource for electricians ready to stop trading time for money and start building a profitable business'. Covers bidding/estimating, operations, hiring, and marketing, not just technical tips.
channels.verificationMethod: Fetched the channel page directly — About section and keyword list ('How to Start an Electrical Business', 'Profitable Electrical Business') are an exact match for this category's purpose. Independently corroborated by ServiceTitan's and tubics' electrician-channel roundups.

blogs.name: Electrical News
blogs.verificationMethod: Real trade publication, 30+ years, confirmed with an exact feed URL across two independent FeedSpot directories. Explicitly serves contractors with content to 'maintain and grow their businesses', not just technical news.

notes: Global content only — no Nigeria-specific electrical business channel or blog found this round. On books: every candidate found (Electrical Contracting by Michael Sammaritano, various estimating/exam-prep guides) is paid-only on Amazon or Google Books — no free version located, so left at 0/10 rather than substitute a technical exam-prep book for business content.
